Chapter 6901: Dark Teleport

Chapter 6901: Dark Teleport

Guangmai waved, releasing fiery particles into Stygian. Unlike his fallen followers, his light appeared pure and refined.

If someone didn’t know his origin, they would mistake him for being a member of an orthodox sect.

He was there with Mang when they first visited this world. When they established Devouring Alliance, he helped Mang keep it in order.

However, no one had ever heard or seen him devouring, not even the three messengers. Thus, had he fallen to the darkness?

“Boom!” Massive Dark Light laws surged out of the staff and built a domain around Golden Lamp.

When the inhabitants looked up, they were horrified by the inviting darkness. The illumination immediately retaliated and dispersed the domain.

“Fortify!” Guangmai shouted.

“Fortify!” The other immortals did the same.

The dispersing domain, albeit damaged, maintained the containment. After all, this was the combined force of a primordial immortal, five golden immortals, and another twenty grand immortals.

It would take some time for the illumination to destroy the domain completely.

“Buzz.” Guangmai roared and borrowed more power from the dark ocean, creating a portal at the old headquarters.

The ripples of this portal could reach the deepest area of Golden Lamp, connecting with another spatial pillar there.

The two sides connected Golden Lamp and Stygian, making them only separated by a thin membrane.

“Now!” Guangmai told the sixty-seven overlords.

“Combine for more power.” Controller said while arranging the sixty-seven overlords into a formation. This was rather effective since they were fused through the staff of authority already.

“Go!” They roared and transformed into a dark creature surging toward the portal.

As they pierced through the membrane, another membrane appeared on the other side in Golden Lamp, completing the teleportation.

The dark creature was immediately met with illumination, gradually melting apart.

“Go now!” Guangmai ordered.

The wave-like beast surged for Li Qiye. Alas, the closer it came, the stronger the suppression. It burned their outer layer into a dark liquid.

With the devil hearts assaulted, their dao hearts became bright again.

“Ahh!” These dao hearts suppressed their strength, unable to move.

Faces within the beast twisted in agony. These dao hearts were once incredible and now, they wanted to kill the heart devils.

“Keep going!” Guangmai shouted.

“Go!” The overlords had no choice and tried to reach for the world’s heart. Alas, they couldn’t take another step forward.
